reason: The cited evidence does not address tribo-corrosion or mechanical disruption of passive films. E1 describes static corrosion testing of a coated steel, E2 shows cumulative surface damage (not sliding wear) reduces corrosion resistance in a HEA, E3 reports static corrosion resistance of a RHEA with no wear, and E4 only mentions wear rate calculation without corrosion. None of the key premises about sliding wear disrupting a passive film or the synergistic degradation mechanism are supported by the cited passages.
premises: HEAs form a self-healing passive oxide film in NaCl solution
Sliding wear mechanically disrupts this passive film
Film disruption exposes fresh metal to chloride ions, accelerating localized corrosion
Combined wear and corrosion causes greater degradation than the sum of isolated processes
Electrochemical impedance and XPS can detect passive film integrity changes
